situation: Strike sortie accepted; starting up the aircraft on deck.
line: Tower copies. Starting the go aircraft.

situation: Strike sortie accepted while fighters sit on alert; launch them now.
line: Tower copies. Launch the alert five!

situation: Flight deck announcement: pilots man up and start engines.
line: On the flight deck. Check chocks, tie-downs and loose gear. Start the go aircraft.

situation: Aircraft hooked to the catapult; clear to launch.
Order to put fighters on five-minute alert.
The alert fighters are manned and ready.
line: Alert five is manned and ready.

situation: Order to change the alert aircraft's weapons.
line: Tower copies. Ordnance, re-arm the alert aircraft.
Negative. No aircraft ready on deck.

situation: Sortie refused: target out of strike range.
line: Negative. Target is outside strike range.

situation: Flight deck announcement: aircraft coming in to land.
line: Stand by to recover aircraft. Clear the landing area.

situation: Telling the returning pilots to come in and land (signal Charlie).
The last aircraft has landed and parked.
